optTagline.message: Hover a hyperlink to get a menu of ways to open it.

optDemoLine1.message: Chrome ships a lot of quiet detail, and

optDemoLine2.message: the $link$ is a good example of it.

optDemoLine3.message: Most of it you never have to think about.

optStep1Lead.message: Hover the mouse over a link

optStep1Body.message: in a page's text. Moving restarts the wait, so reading never triggers anything, and links in navigation bars, headers and sidebars are skipped.

optStep3Body.message: and they open into the action bar. Press Esc, scroll, or move away to dismiss it.

optNoNetwork.message: HyLink sends nothing anywhere — no analytics, no network requests. Your settings sync through your Chrome profile and never leave it.

optEnableHint.message: Turn the hover menu on everywhere.

optModeHandle.message: Show a small grip, expand on hover

optModeImmediate.message: Show the full menu right away

optModeHint.message: The grip keeps links readable while you browse — the full menu only appears once you move onto it (or hold the modifier key).

optDelay.message: Hover a link this long before it appears

optDelayHint.message: Moving the pointer restarts this, so sweeping across text while reading never triggers the menu.

optRequireModifier.message: Only show while a modifier key is held

optRequireModifierHint.message: Keeps the menu out of the way until you ask for it.

optActionsHint.message: Drag a row, or use the arrows, to put the menu in the order you want. Unticking one leaves it out.

optNewTabActiveHint.message: Off means "Open in new tab" opens it in the background.

optCleanFirst.message: Remove tracking parameters from links you open

optCleanFirstHint.message: On by default. Every way of opening a link — new tab, window, incognito, side by side — goes to the stripped URL. The copy buttons are unaffected: "Copy link address" always copies the link exactly as it is, and "Copy clean link" is the one that strips.

optSkipNavHint.message: Only offer actions on links in the page's own text. Hold the modifier key to get the menu on a navigation link anyway.

optSites.message: Never show on these sites — one hostname per line. Subdomains are covered too —
